questions.stem: What is a disadvantage of cloning?

options.text: Clones have too much genetic variation
All clones are genetically identical, so they are all vulnerable to the same diseases
Cloning produces too many different types of organisms
Cloning takes longer than selective breeding

questions.explanation: Since clones are genetically identical, they all share the same weaknesses. If a disease affects one individual, it could wipe out the entire cloned population because none would have resistance.
